title: PC-12 NGX Mastery: Finally Understand Every Display!
description:
Finally, master the Pilatus PC-12 NGX cockpit and Honeywell Primus Apex systems in MSFS 2024. We break down the PC-12 NGX start of the systems, engine start and a quick IFR flight planning so you can fly with total confidence.

In this second installment of our PC-12 NGX series, we move from the external pre-flight to the internal systems. We cover the electrical bus logic, the EPS, and exactly how to read the complex PFD and MFD displays. If you want to stop guessing and start flying the NGX like a veteran, this is the episode for you.

📖 Chapters: 
0:00 - intro
0:52 - Pilatus PC-12 NGX - The silent office
1:34 - The physical inspection: external walkaround
6:46 - Digital Command - Powering up the ACE  
24:16 - The heartbeat of the beast - FADEC startup
29:05 - The digital navigator - Programming the flight
40:40 - Summary - next steps
